items.sentence: Today, the pond ecosystem includes frogs, fish, and green plants.
Today, the desert glowed orange under the late evening sun.
One strange sea creature glided past the glass window.
The mature oak offered shade to the whole yard.
Fences protect the wetland habitat from nearby construction.
Today, gardeners maintain the park paths through every busy season.
Today, the tide left tiny shells along the wet shore.
Today, the heron kept perfect balance on one thin leg.
One grand waterfall thundered into the deep green pool.
Today, the town will grant land for a new garden.
